messages:
emma: FYI: customers reported spikes of 502/504 and mTLS handshake failures in us-west after the RBAC hardening rollout this morning. Saw several alerts at 08:12 UTC. Anyone oncall?

vikram: I'm seeing the same. Traces show failed session ticket resumption and TLS alerts 42/40 from proxies.

emma: Example trace id trc-usw-0310-9f7b. Logs: 
```
2026-04-10T08:11:58Z svc-api -> proxy-usw handshake_start
2026-04-10T08:11:59Z proxy-usw handshake_ticket_fetch 620ms
2026-04-10T08:12:00Z proxy-usw handshake_failed TLS alert 42
2026-04-10T08:12:00Z svc-api -> proxy-usw fallback_to_tcp
```

tess: Curious: last night's change removed wildcard role "keystore-audit-writer" and replaced it with scoped roles. deploy-bot: which IAM diffs applied?

deploy-bot: terraform apply infra/iam @ 2026-04-10T07:50:12Z replaced binding `roles/keystore.auditor` -> removed `keystore-audit-writer` for service account `keystore-service`.

vikram: Control-plane keystore logs show this around 08:10: `keystore: audit write failed: PermissionDenied: iam permission denied to write_audit_log` then fallback to best-effort with no write. Also saw `keystore: session_ticket_decrypt failed: key_handle_unavailable` immediately after.

emma: If audit writes are failing, our keystore code has a safety path that refuses to expose session-ticket encryption keys when audit logging is not guaranteed. That may be the intended hardening but it wasn't coordinated with proxy timeout behavior.

tess: That safety path is new from the vuln triage change last month (CVE mitigations around session ticket replay). It requires audit logging to be available before enabling ticket reuse keys. Looks like RBAC change removed the ability to write logs before the keystore SA was granted the new scoped logger role.

vikram: That explains the chain: RBAC change -> audit writes fail -> keystore refuses to hand out ticket keys -> proxies can't resume sessions -> clients attempt full handshakes, some exceed handshake timeout -> fallback and 502s.

emma: Repro steps I ran locally against staging keystore after removing audit role: 
```
$ curl -XPOST https://keystore.staging.internal/v1/unseal -d'{"rotate":true}'
{"status":"audit_unavailable: refusing session_ticket key material"}
```

deploy-bot: No other deploys to keystore or proxy in that window. Only the IAM change.

tess: Remediation plan (hot): 1) restore audit write permission for keystore-service (undo RBAC diff) 2) restart keystore control-plane pods to pick up perms 3) rolling restart of proxies to pick up session ticket keys 4) short-term: disable session-ticket gating feature via feature-flag to restore traffic quickly if rollback isn't instant.

emma: I'll open the rollback terraform and request expedited approval. PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/iam/pulls/4512 (rollback keystore-audit change).

vikram: Also add observability: a specific metric `keystore.audit_write_ok` and an alert if it drops below 99.9% for 5m. And an audit trail check in the IAM runbook to ensure new roles include logger.write.

tess: For postmortem include: IAM diff, timeline of audit write failures, affected regions (us-west), number of failed resumptions and customer-facing errors, and why the safety gate existed (CVE mitigation notes). We'll also add a preflight check in the RBAC deployment pipeline to call `keystore:smoke-audit-write` before applying changes.

emma: Rolling back now. Patch ticket: INC-2026-1148.

ops-bot: Issuing rollback at 2026-04-10T08:15:20Z.

vikram: After rollback and restart: `keystore: audit_write OK` at 08:18 and `session_ticket_decrypt` success metrics returned to baseline by 08:22. Proxy telemetry shows handshake latency normalizing.

emma: Quick checklist for immediate follow-ups:
- [ ] RBAC rollback confirmed and PR merged
- [ ] add keystore.audit_write_ok metric & alert
- [ ] add IAM pipeline preflight smoke test
- [ ] update change approval to include security gating impacts (feature flags)
- [ ] postmortem and CVE mitigation doc update

tess: I'll own the postmortem draft. Assigning action items in the ticket. Marking incident P2 -> P1 for the rollback window. :white_check_mark:
